text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-INC-4182 — model-catalog default revision changed resulting in tokenizer mismatch exceptions. Auto-paging eng-runtime on-call. Link: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-4182>

pagerduty: Paging ashton (primary). Escalation policy: eng-runtime -> eng-infra. Severity: P1.

ashton: ack. Jumping on this. Any quick summary?

sara: seeing a spike of tokenizer errors in inference logs: "vocab size mismatch" and "tokenizer hash mismatch" across several pods. Started ~13:02 UTC. 5xxs and parsing errors up.

ryan: CX reports two EU customers with broken embeddings/generation. Volume small (~0.6%) but affects SLA for those tenants.

ashton: checked catalog: `openlm/llama2-13b-custom` default_revision -> r3.0, available revisions r2.7, r3.0. r3.0 was onboarded earlier today but tokenizer migration step wasn't applied. Looks like default was flipped accidentally by automation.

ashton: immediate mitigation: revert default_revision to r2.7 and invalidate caches. Plan: revert -> invalidate prefix caches -> monitor error rate -> notify customers -> follow-ups.

ashton: running rollback command now:

```
# revert default for the catalog entry
rictl catalog update --model openlm/llama2-13b-custom --set default_revision=r2.7 --reason "emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch"
```

incident-bot: Change queued: cd-8941. Deployment to control plane in progress.

ashton: change applied. default_revision is now r2.7. Triggering cache invalidation:

```
rictl cache invalidate --model openlm/llama2-13b-custom --scope prefix
```

sara: observing error rate dropping on serving logs. 5xxs trending down to baseline within ~60s. Tokenizer exception logs reduced significantly.

nina-pm: which customers got hit? Need to start comms ASAP.

ryan: CX tickets #7892 and #7893 opened. Both confirmed degraded output. One customer switched to a fallback model on their side. I've messaged them with interim note and ETA for resolution.

ashton: note for escalation: if rollback fails, escalate to eng-infra@pagerduty. For now we'll monitor for 30 minutes.

ashton: preliminary root cause: onboarding automation (`model-onboarder`) set `set-default: true` while `tokenizer-migration: pending`. Bad default was allowed through.

sara: confirmed in catalog audit: onboarder commit shows `set-default: true` and migration flag not set. Looks like a logic bug in onboarding pipeline.

ryan: immediate follow-ups proposed:
- add a validation gate to block `set-default` when tokenizer migration is pending
- add a preflight check that compares tokenizer vocab hash between model revision and catalog baseline
- create an alert for sudden spike in tokenizer exceptions

ashton: creating follow-up tickets and will own initial postmortem draft. Also creating a short-lived runbook entry for emergency rollback command (above).

ashton: Handoff -> ops-shift. Timeline: rollback executed at 1763001303, error rate normalized by ~1763001368, customers notified and CX tickets created. Follow-ups: PM ticket #PM-789, Engineering task #ENG-452, onboarding patch PR-5570.

ops-shift: ack. Will monitor for next 30m and escalate if recurrence. Postmortem owner set to ashton. Adding notes to incident page.

nina-pm: communications: we'll draft a short customer-facing note: what happened, impact, mitigation, next steps. Keep it technical but customer-friendly.

incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" for on-call; creating postmortem tracking card and tagging participants.

ashton: quick dev notes: opened PR 5570 to require tokenizer validation in `model-onboarder` and block `set-default` until migration completes. Will request expedited review.

sara: running a sweep across catalog for similar bad defaults — found 4 additional models where `set-default true` and `migration: pending`. Rolling those back to previous revisions now with the same script.

ryan: good find. Please include list in postmortem.

ashton: summary for handoff: reverted 5 models total, cache invalidation performed, customer notifications sent, PR to fix onboarding opened. Action items assigned and owners documented.

ops-shift: closing monitoring window with no regressions. Will leave page open for postmortem until required docs are in.

ryan: thanks everyone. Short and sharp. :thumbsup:

sara: logging artifacts and diffs uploaded to incident page (s3://redwood-incidents/PD-INC-4182).

ashton: final note: once PR lands we should run a full catalog audit and add an automated test to CI to catch tokenizer/hash mismatches before any default flips.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Postmortem card created: PM-789.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: ashton, :eyes: sara, :loudspeaker: nina-pm)
